question: What are the core management responsibilities of an operating system?
correct: Managing processes, storage file systems, and hardware memory allocation
incorrect: Compiling source code automatically into high-level Python scripts
Designing graphics layout templates for web browser client windows
Encrypting all incoming network emails before saving them to disk
feedback: The operating system acts as the software manager between applications and hardware, overseeing processes, files, and memory.

question: In operating systems, what is a process?
correct: An instance of a running program managed and scheduled by the OS
incorrect: A permanent file path string stored on a physical hard disk partition
A hardware bus wire connecting the CPU directly to the monitor display
A single line of text written inside a Python source code module
feedback: A process is an active, executing program instance managed (started, scheduled, and isolated) by the operating system.

question: What is the primary role of the Domain Name System (DNS) on the internet?
correct: Translating human-readable domain names into numeric IP addresses
incorrect: Encrypting password credentials entered into web browser forms
Compressing large HTML pages before sending them across network links
Formatting JSON data objects returned by remote application APIs
feedback: DNS functions as the internet's phonebook, mapping domain names (like example.com) to numeric IP addresses.

question: Why does one crashing app usually not take down the whole machine?
correct: The OS gives each process protected memory and mediates hardware
incorrect: Modern apps are written so carefully that crashes stay local
Each app runs on a separate processor core of its own
The hardware detects the crash and restarts that app
feedback: Programs ask the OS for what they need rather than commanding the hardware, and the OS decides. That mediation is the protection.

question: What is an IP address?
correct: A numeric identifier assigned to a device connected to a network
incorrect: A secret password required to log into a local Wi-Fi router network
A physical serial number burned into a computer CPU during manufacturing
A filename extension indicating that a file contains Python code
feedback: An IP (Internet Protocol) address is a unique numeric address identifying a device on a network.

question: How does Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) ensure reliable data delivery across the internet?
correct: By numbering packets, confirming receipt, and retransmitting lost packets
incorrect: By sending all message data inside a single uninterrupted laser pulse
By requiring web servers to store every page file in uncompressed format
By deleting network requests that take longer than one millisecond
feedback: TCP provides reliable, ordered data stream delivery by breaking data into numbered packets and retransmitting missing ones.

question: Looking up the same big website twice can return different IP addresses. Why?
correct: Large sites run many machines behind one name, and DNS shares them
incorrect: The address changes each time a page on the site is edited
DNS invents an address when the real one is unavailable
Each user is permanently assigned their own copy of the site
feedback: DNS acts like a receptionist directing a queue. It is also why a stale or wrong DNS entry can make a site vanish for one region while everyone else sees nothing wrong.

question: The network protocol that breaks messages into chunks called packets and manages their routing is ___.
correct: IP
Internet Protocol
feedback: IP (Internet Protocol) specifies how data packets are formatted and routed across network boundaries.

question: The standard protocol spoken between web browsers and web servers to request pages is ___.
correct: HTTP
HTTPS
feedback: HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol) is the application-layer foundation of web request/response communication.

question: What does TCP add on top of packets?
correct: Numbering, confirmation, re-sending, and reassembly in order
incorrect: The name-to-address lookup before the message is sent
Encryption of the contents so they are unreadable
The rule that the largest packets are delivered first
feedback: It works like a parcel-tracking system: number every parcel, confirm each arrival, re-send anything unconfirmed, and reassemble in order. The message arrives complete, or the sender knows it did not.

question: The three-digit HTTP response status code that indicates a requested resource was successfully found is ___.
feedback: Status code 200 OK signifies that an HTTP request succeeded and the response payload is returned.

question: The three-digit HTTP response status code that indicates a requested web page was not found is ___.
feedback: Status code 404 Not Found indicates that the server cannot locate the requested resource URI.

question: Which of the following HTTP status codes represent server-side errors? (Select all that apply)
correct: 500 Internal Server Error
503 Service Unavailable
incorrect: 200 OK
404 Not Found
feedback: 5xx status codes (like 500 and 503) indicate that the server encountered an error while attempting to fulfill a request.

question: Which of the following are layers in the four-layer TCP/IP network model? (Select all that apply)
correct: Application layer
Transport layer
Internet layer
incorrect: Database layer
Graphics layer
feedback: The standard TCP/IP 4-layer model consists of Application, Transport, Internet, and Link layers.

question: Which of the following components are part of an HTTP request message? (Select all that apply)
correct: Request method (GET or POST)
Target path URL
Header key-value pairs
incorrect: SQL database table index
CPU register memory address
feedback: An HTTP request consists of an HTTP method, path, headers (like Host and Content-Type), and an optional body.

question: Match each cloud service model to its description.

pairs.definition: Renting raw virtual servers, storage, and networking hardware
Renting a managed platform to deploy code without managing servers
Using completed software applications hosted and managed by a vendor
Owning and maintaining physical server hardware in your own building

feedback: IaaS provides raw infrastructure, PaaS offers application deployment platforms, SaaS delivers end-user software, and on-premises uses self-owned hardware.

question: A request is sent for a page that does not exist, and the program receives a 404 without crashing. What does this show?
correct: The server answered normally; the code reports it missing
incorrect: The request completely failed to reach the server
The network dropped all the packets on the way back
The client library failed to parse the response body
feedback: No crash and no silence — just a calm verdict meaning that is not a thing. Status codes are how HTTP reports failure as data rather than as an accident.

question: Match each web component to its primary role.

pairs.definition: Translates domain names to IP addresses
Answers client program requests with JSON data
Maps a URL path to a Python handler function

feedback: DNS maps names to IPs, headers carry request metadata, APIs exchange structured data, and Flask routes match paths to code.

question: A web server processes {{req_per_sec}} requests per second. How many requests does it process in {{seconds}} seconds?
feedback_template: Processing {{req_per_sec}} requests/sec for {{seconds}} seconds yields {{expected}} total requests.

question: A file of {{size_mb}} MB is sent in packets of {{packet_kb}} KB. Assuming 1 MB = 1000 KB, how many packets are sent?
feedback_template: Converting {{size_mb}} MB to {{size_mb * 1000}} KB and dividing by {{packet_kb}} KB gives {{expected}} packets.

question: What is an Application Programming Interface (API) in the context of web applications?
correct: A web service designed to return structured data like JSON to code
incorrect: A graphical user interface tool used to draw website icons and images
A physical hardware cable connecting network switches inside a server room
A compiler tool that converts Python scripts into standalone executable binaries
feedback: A web API provides endpoints that applications call over HTTP to retrieve or update structured data (commonly JSON).

question: Which Python library is widely used to make HTTP requests to web servers and APIs?
correct: requests
incorrect: math
random
sys
feedback: Python's `requests` library allows programs to send HTTP GET, POST, and other requests easily.

question: What method on a Python `requests` response object parses JSON body text into a Python dictionary or list?
correct: .json()
incorrect: .parse()
.dict()
.to_python()
feedback: The `.json()` method on a `requests.Response` object decodes the JSON payload into corresponding Python data structures.

question: Which of these are true of Google Colab, in cloud terms? (Select all that apply)
correct: It is finished software used through a browser, which is SaaS
It hands you a managed Linux machine to run code on
incorrect: It gives you bare virtual machines needing an OS installed
It runs wholly on your own computer, with no server involved
feedback: You have been a cloud customer all semester. The Linux box whose processes you can list is a slice of someone else's computer.

question: What is Flask in the Python ecosystem?
correct: A micro web framework for writing web servers and defining HTTP routes
incorrect: A database engine used exclusively for storing large binary video files
A command-line text editor used to edit files directly on remote Linux servers
A machine learning tool designed for training artificial neural networks
feedback: Flask is a lightweight Python web framework used to handle HTTP requests, define routes, and render web pages.

question: In a web server like Flask, what is a route?
correct: A mapping between a specific URL path and the Python function that handles it
incorrect: A physical fiber optic cable route between two cloud server data centers
A background database query that runs automatically once per hour on disk
A list of external IP addresses blocked by a network router firewall
feedback: A route pairs a URL path (like `/api/users`) with a handler function that executes when a request arrives at that path.

question: What is the purpose of dynamic URL parameters in Flask routes (such as `/user/<int:user_id>`)?
correct: Extracting variable values directly from the request URL path into function arguments
incorrect: Restricting web page access exclusively to users connecting from specific IP addresses
Encrypting the response HTML content before sending it back to the web browser
Preventing web browsers from caching static CSS stylesheets and images locally
feedback: URL parameters capture dynamic values from the requested URL path and pass them as arguments to the handler function.

question: In a web application, an HTML file containing placeholders for dynamic server data is called a ___.
correct: template
feedback: Templates are HTML files with placeholder tags where web servers insert dynamic data before serving the page.

question: The protocol layer responsible for end-to-end packet delivery between IP addresses is the ___ layer.
correct: Internet
IP
feedback: The Internet layer (using IP) handles routing packets across networks between host IP addresses.

question: Which of the following statements accurately describe cloud computing? (Select all that apply)
correct: Cloud resources are rented on demand over a network connection
Cloud providers manage physical server hardware and facilities
incorrect: Cloud computing eliminates the need for software code testing
Cloud services run without using physical computers or disk storage
feedback: Cloud computing lets teams rent computing resources on demand over the internet without owning physical hardware facilities.

question: The notebook says most web pages do not exist until you ask for them. What does that mean?
correct: A function builds the HTML on the spot from data and returns it
incorrect: Pages are stored as files but deleted after each visitor leaves
Pages are assembled inside the browser from data it already had
Pages exist just while a database query is still running
feedback: There is no file anywhere holding your social feed or your bank statement page. A page is just a string a server computed — and you already know how to compute strings.

question: Which of the following are examples of HTTP request methods? (Select all that apply)
correct: GET
POST
DELETE
incorrect: FETCH_ALL
SELECT_WHERE
feedback: GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE are standard HTTP methods (verbs) defining the desired action on a resource.

question: What happens during the web request/response cycle when a user clicks a link in a browser?
correct: The browser sends an HTTP request to the server, which runs code and sends back an HTTP response
incorrect: The browser directly opens and edits the Python source files stored on the remote server disk
The server sends a CPU interrupt signal over Wi-Fi to shut down the client browser window
The browser downloads the entire database table grid into local system memory before displaying text
feedback: In the request/response cycle, the client sends an HTTP request, the server processes it, and returns an HTTP response.

question: A streaming site is down in one city but fine in another, and down at busy times but fine at quiet ones. Investigation found one of three server processes had crashed days earlier with nothing restarting it. Why does that explain the pattern?
correct: Requests routed to the dead process vanished, more often when busy
incorrect: A crashed process makes DNS return the wrong address in nearby regions
The remaining processes ran more slowly because one was missing
TCP stopped confirming packets once a server process ended
feedback: Two survivors coped most of the time, so the failure looked random and regional. Listing the machine's processes — the very first tool in the notebook — would have shown a corpse in the table.

question: Why do modern web servers use HTML templates instead of serving static files for every request?
correct: Templates let servers dynamically inject real-time data into HTML structures before returning them
incorrect: Templates allow servers to bypass network encryption and transmit plain text faster over Wi-Fi
Templates eliminate the need for web browsers to render visual CSS layout styles on screen
Templates prevent web search engines from indexing the contents of public website pages
feedback: Templates allow web applications to combine reusable HTML structures with dynamic, real-time database content.

question: Match each HTTP status code range to its general category.

pairs.definition: Success — the request was successfully received and processed
Redirection — further action must be taken to complete the request
Client Error — the request contains bad syntax or cannot be found
Server Error — the server failed to fulfill an apparently valid request

feedback: 2xx indicates success, 3xx redirection, 4xx client errors (like 404), and 5xx server failures (like 500).

question: What is the function of HTTP headers in a web conversation?
correct: Carrying metadata about the request or response, such as Content-Type or User-Agent
incorrect: Storing the compiled machine code instructions executed by the web server CPU
Encrypting the physical copper wires connecting internet routers across backbones
Holding the SQL primary key indexes used to search database table records
feedback: HTTP headers pass additional metadata (like content type, length, authorization credentials, and cookies) between client and server.

question: A server returns a JSON array of {{count}} items. If each item contains {{fields}} fields, how many total field values are returned?
feedback_template: Multiplying {{count}} items by {{fields}} fields per item yields {{expected}} total field values.

question: Which of these are reasons a company might choose SaaS over IaaS? (Select all that apply)
correct: Nobody on the team has to manage an operating system or servers
The software is ready to use immediately through a browser
incorrect: It gives the most control over exactly how the machines are configured
It is the model that keeps data on the company's own hardware
It removes the need for any network connection
feedback: SaaS trades control for convenience: you are a user, and nothing underneath is your problem. IaaS is the opposite trade — total control and total responsibility.

question: What is the primary role of DNS caching in web networking?
correct: Storing recently looked-up domain IP mappings locally to reduce network query delays
incorrect: Compressing HTML web page files before they are written to a web server's hard disk
Translating Python source code instructions into lower-level assembly language
Preventing unauthorized users from connecting to private home Wi-Fi networks
feedback: DNS caching saves recent domain-to-IP lookup results in local memory so subsequent requests avoid repeated DNS server lookups.
